items.title: Designing more efficient quantum circuits with Claude
items.reason: Anthropic's Claude Mythos 5 autonomously redesigned 8 quantum circuits in a closed evaluator loop, beating published records (e.g. 17x fewer gates on elliptic-curve point addition, ~12x gate reduction on a Reed-Solomon decoder vs Google's construction) — a concrete, verifiable AI-for-science result with numbers, not a demo.
key_facts: Claude given 8 plain-language quantum-circuit specs (chemistry, optimization, physics sim, number theory)
Worked in closed loop with automated evaluator, no human input between rounds; score = qubits x gates
Elliptic-curve point addition: 53 hours of work, 12% more qubits but 17x fewer gates than smallest prior design

Reed-Solomon decoder: switched to Berlekamp-Massey decoding, cut gate count ~12x vs Google's prior construction; worst-case storage fell from 665 qubits to a 19-qubit reserve (403M simulated decodings, ~1-in-10,000 failure rate)
Model was overly cautious/conservative; team had to force parallel divergent approaches
No code repo linked; only the arXiv paper (2610.22367)

items.title: Why harnesses matter for energy (and token) efficiency
items.reason: Data-driven look (30 days production traffic + controlled lab tests) at how agent harnesses affect prompt-cache hit rate, and therefore energy/latency: cache misses cost 91-140% more energy per request, and client choice swings uncached-input rate from 1.6% to 11.1%. Directly on the 'how models are served' line the profile cares about.
key_facts: Uncached-input share by client: 1.6% (deepseek-harness) to 11.1% (Node.js apps); 92% cached implies ~2.7x the prefill work of 97% cached
Cache-break rate ~1/100 turns for deepseek-harness vs ~3/100 for OpenCode and Pi
A mostly-uncached request used ~91% more energy on DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, ~140% more on GLM-5.3
Past 128k tokens, ~3/1000 turns re-read most of the prompt; one such turn costs as much prefill as ~600 normal turns (TTFT 5-41s vs 0.8-2.8s)
Lab test: 65 of 539 follow-up requests across 4 agents broke the cache, e.g. via OpenCode's plan-mode reminder
Caveat: published by Neuralwatt, which sells the cloud service being measured

OpenCode working with Anthropic, OpenAI, Google on remediation; incident ongoing
